verses.original: אִיּ֗וֹב וַיֹּאמַֽר׃ וַיַּ֥עַן
verses.transliteration: ’î·yō·wḇ way·yō·mar way·ya·‘an
verses.literal: Then Job . . . answered

verses.original: אָ֭מְנָם כִּ֣י אַתֶּם־ עָ֑ם וְ֝עִמָּכֶ֗ם חָכְמָֽה׃ תָּמ֥וּת
verses.transliteration: ’ā·mə·nām kî ’at·tem- ‘ām wə·‘im·mā·ḵem ḥāḵ·māh tā·mūṯ
verses.literal: Truly then you are the people with [whom] wisdom [itself] will die

verses.original: גַּם־ לִ֤י לֵבָ֨ב׀ כְּֽמוֹכֶ֗ם אָנֹכִ֣י לֹא־ נֹפֵ֣ל מִכֶּ֑ם וְאֶת־ מִי־ אֵ֥ין כְּמוֹ־ אֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.transliteration: gam- lî lê·ḇāḇ kə·mō·w·ḵem ’ā·nō·ḵî lō- nō·p̄êl mik·kem wə·’eṯ- mî- ’ên kə·mōw- ’êl·leh
verses.literal: But I also have a mind . . . I am not inferior to you . . . Who does not [know] such things as these

verses.original: אֶֽהְיֶ֗ה שְׂחֹ֤ק לְרֵעֵ֨הוּ׀ קֹרֵ֣א לֶ֭אֱלוֹהַּ וַֽיַּעֲנֵ֑הוּ צַדִּ֥יק תָּמִֽים׃ שְׂ֝ח֗וֹק
verses.transliteration: ’eh·yeh śə·ḥōq lə·rê·‘ê·hū qō·rê le·’ĕ·lō·w·ah way·ya·‘ă·nê·hū ṣad·dîq tā·mîm śə·ḥôq
verses.literal: I am a laughingstock to my friends though I called on God and He answered The righteous and upright man is a laughingstock

verses.original: שַׁאֲנָ֑ן בּ֭וּז לַפִּ֣יד לְעַשְׁתּ֣וּת נָ֝כ֗וֹן רָֽגֶל׃ לְמ֣וֹעֲדֵי
verses.transliteration: ša·’ă·nān būz lap·pîḏ lə·‘aš·tūṯ nā·ḵō·wn rā·ḡel lə·mō·w·‘ă·ḏê
verses.literal: The one at ease scorns misfortune as the fate . . . of those whose feet are slipping

verses.original: אֹֽהָלִ֨ים׀ לְשֹׁ֥דְדִ֗ים יִשְׁלָ֤יוּ לְמַרְגִּ֣יזֵי אֵ֑ל לַאֲשֶׁ֤ר וּֽ֭בַטֻּחוֹת הֵבִ֖יא אֱל֣וֹהַּ בְּיָדֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ō·hā·lîm lə·šō·ḏə·ḏîm yiš·lā·yū lə·mar·gî·zê ’êl la·’ă·šer ū·ḇaṭ·ṭu·ḥō·wṯ hê·ḇî ’ĕ·lō·w·ah bə·yā·ḏōw
verses.literal: The tents of robbers are safe and those who provoke God - are secure those who carry their god in their hands

verses.original: וְֽאוּלָ֗ם שְׁאַל־ נָ֣א בְהֵמ֣וֹת וְתֹרֶ֑ךָּ וְע֥וֹף הַ֝שָּׁמַ֗יִם וְיַגֶּד־ לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ū·lām šə·’al- nā ḇə·hê·mō·wṯ wə·ṯō·re·kā wə·‘ō·wp̄ haš·šā·ma·yim wə·yag·geḏ- lāḵ
verses.literal: But ask . . . the animals and they will instruct you ask the birds of the air and they will tell you

verses.original: א֤וֹ שִׂ֣יחַ לָאָ֣רֶץ וְתֹרֶ֑ךָּ דְּגֵ֣י הַיָּֽם׃ וִֽיסַפְּר֥וּ לְ֝ךָ֗
verses.transliteration: ’ōw śî·aḥ lā·’ā·reṣ wə·ṯō·re·kā də·ḡê hay·yām wî·sap·pə·rū lə·ḵā
verses.literal: Or speak to the earth and it will teach you let the fish of the sea inform you

verses.original: מִ֭י בְּכָל־ אֵ֑לֶּה לֹא־ יָדַ֣ע כִּ֥י יַד־ יְ֝הוָה עָ֣שְׂתָה זֹּֽאת׃
verses.transliteration: mî bə·ḵāl ’êl·leh lō- yā·ḏa‘ kî yaḏ- Yah·weh ‘ā·śə·ṯāh zōṯ
verses.literal: Which of all these does not know that the hand of the LORD has done this

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֣ר נֶ֣פֶשׁ כָּל־ חָ֑י בְּ֭יָדוֹ וְ֝ר֗וּחַ כָּל־ בְּשַׂר־ אִֽישׁ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer ne·p̄eš kāl- ḥāy bə·yā·ḏōw wə·rū·aḥ kāl- bə·śar- ’îš
verses.literal: - The life of every living thing is in His hand as well as the breath of all mankind . . .

verses.original: הֲלֹא־ אֹ֭זֶן תִּבְחָ֑ן מִלִּ֣ין וְ֝חֵ֗ךְ יִטְעַם־ לֽוֹ׃ אֹ֣כֶל
verses.transliteration: hă·lō- ’ō·zen tiḇ·ḥān mil·lîn wə·ḥêḵ yiṭ·‘am- lōw ’ō·ḵel
verses.literal: Does not the ear test words as the tongue tastes its food

verses.original: חָכְמָ֑ה בִּֽישִׁישִׁ֥ים תְּבוּנָֽה׃ וְאֹ֖רֶךְ יָמִ֣ים
verses.transliteration: ḥāḵ·māh bî·šî·šîm tə·ḇū·nāh wə·’ō·reḵ yā·mîm
verses.literal: Wisdom is found with the elderly and understanding comes with long life

verses.original: חָכְמָ֣ה וּגְבוּרָ֑ה ל֝֗וֹ עִ֭מּוֹ עֵצָ֥ה וּתְבוּנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ḥāḵ·māh ū·ḡə·ḇū·rāh lōw ‘im·mōw ‘ê·ṣāh ū·ṯə·ḇū·nāh
verses.literal: Wisdom and strength belong to God counsel and understanding are His

verses.original: הֵ֣ן יַ֭הֲרוֹס וְלֹ֣א יִבָּנֶ֑ה אִ֝֗ישׁ יִסְגֹּ֥ר עַל־ וְלֹ֣א יִפָּתֵֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: hên ya·hă·rō·ws wə·lō yib·bā·neh ’îš yis·gōr ‘al- wə·lō yip·pā·ṯê·aḥ
verses.literal: What He tears down cannot be rebuilt the man He imprisons . . . cannot be released

verses.original: הֵ֤ן יַעְצֹ֣ר בַּמַּ֣יִם וְיִבָ֑שׁוּ וִֽ֝ישַׁלְּחֵ֗ם וְיַ֖הַפְכוּ אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: hên ya‘·ṣōr bam·ma·yim wə·yi·ḇā·šū wî·šal·lə·ḥêm wə·ya·hap̄·ḵū ’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: If He holds back the waters they dry up and if He releases them they overwhelm the land

verses.original: וְתֽוּשִׁיָּ֑ה ל֝֗וֹ עֹ֣ז עִ֭מּוֹ שֹׁגֵ֥ג וּמַשְׁגֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ṯū·šī·yå̄h lōw ‘ōz ‘im·mōw šō·ḡêḡ ū·maš·geh
verses.literal: True wisdom and power belong to Him The deceived and the deceiver [are His]

verses.original: יוֹעֲצִ֣ים מוֹלִ֣יךְ שׁוֹלָ֑ל יְהוֹלֵֽל׃ וְֽשֹׁפְטִ֥ים
verses.transliteration: yō·w·‘ă·ṣîm mō·w·lîḵ šō·w·lāl yə·hō·w·lêl wə·šō·p̄ə·ṭîm
verses.literal: He leads counselors away barefoot and makes fools of judges

verses.original: פִּתֵּ֑חַ מוּסַ֣ר מְלָכִ֣ים וַיֶּאְסֹ֥ר אֵ֝ז֗וֹר בְּמָתְנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: pit·tê·aḥ mū·sar mə·lā·ḵîm way·ye’·sōr ’ê·zō·wr bə·mā·ṯə·nê·hem
verses.literal: He loosens the bonds placed by kings and fastens a belt around their waists

verses.original: כֹּהֲנִ֣ים מוֹלִ֣יךְ שׁוֹלָ֑ל יְסַלֵּֽף׃ וְאֵֽתָנִ֣ים
verses.transliteration: kō·hă·nîm mō·w·lîḵ šō·w·lāl yə·sal·lêp̄ wə·’ê·ṯā·nîm
verses.literal: He leads priests away barefoot and overthrows the established

verses.original: מֵסִ֣יר לְנֶאֱמָנִ֑ים שָׂ֭פָה יִקָּֽח׃ וְטַ֖עַם זְקֵנִ֣ים
verses.transliteration: mê·sîr lə·ne·’ĕ·mā·nîm śā·p̲āh yiq·qāḥ wə·ṭa·‘am zə·qê·nîm
verses.literal: He deprives the trusted of speech and takes away the discernment of elders

verses.original: שׁוֹפֵ֣ךְ בּ֭וּז עַל־ נְדִיבִ֑ים וּמְזִ֖יחַ רִפָּֽה׃ אֲפִיקִ֣ים
verses.transliteration: šō·w·p̄êḵ būz ‘al- nə·ḏî·ḇîm ū·mə·zî·aḥ rip·pāh ’ă·p̄î·qîm
verses.literal: He pours out contempt on nobles and disarms . . . the mighty

verses.original: מְגַלֶּ֣ה עֲ֭מֻקוֹת מִנִּי־ חֹ֑שֶׁךְ וַיֹּצֵ֖א צַלְמָֽוֶת׃ לָא֣וֹר
verses.transliteration: mə·ḡal·leh ‘ă·mu·qō·wṯ min·nî- ḥō·šeḵ way·yō·ṣê ṣal·mā·weṯ lā·’ō·wr
verses.literal: He reveals the deep things of darkness and brings deep shadows into light

verses.original: לַ֭גּוֹיִם מַשְׂגִּ֣יא וַֽיְאַבְּדֵ֑ם שֹׁטֵ֥חַ לַ֝גּוֹיִ֗ם וַיַּנְחֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: lag·gō·w·yim maś·gî way·’ab·bə·ḏêm šō·ṭê·aḥ lag·gō·w·yim way·yan·ḥêm
verses.literal: He makes nations great and destroys them He enlarges nations then disperses them

verses.original: מֵסִ֗יר הָאָ֑רֶץ רָאשֵׁ֣י עַם־ לֵ֭ב וַ֝יַּתְעֵ֗ם לֹא־ דָֽרֶךְ׃ בְּתֹ֣הוּ
verses.transliteration: mê·sîr hā·’ā·reṣ rā·šê ‘am- lêḇ way·yaṯ·‘êm lō- ḏā·reḵ bə·ṯō·hū
verses.literal: He deprives the earth’s leaders of reason and makes them wander in a trackless . . . wasteland

verses.original: יְמַֽשְׁשׁוּ־ חֹ֥שֶׁךְ וְלֹא־ א֑וֹר וַ֝יַּתְעֵ֗ם כַּשִּׁכּֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: yə·maš·šū- ḥō·šeḵ wə·lō- ’ō·wr way·yaṯ·‘êm kaš·šik·kō·wr
verses.literal: They grope in the darkness without light He makes them stagger like drunkards
